summary: This dataset consists of three simultaneous EEG-fMRI datasets from 11, 6, and 12 healthy, right-handed participants, respectively, collected in three conditions: resting-state, respiration task, and reaction time task. Anatomical (T1w) and functional MRI images are provided in raw nifti format, while EEG and peripheral physiology (PPG, Respiratory) data are available in minimally-preprocessed form in.mat files. The dataset includes 15 resting-state scans, 9 respiration task scans, and 12 reaction time task scans, with detailed MRI/EEG acquisition parameters provided.
